meta.name: to-spec
meta.description: Turn the current conversation into a spec and publish it to the project issue tracker — no interview, just synthesis of what you've already discussed.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把讨论内容自动整理成规格并提交到问题系统
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果经常需要把零散讨论变成可执行的规格
copy.tagline_en: Turn conversation into a spec and publish to issue tracker
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often need to convert discussions into actionable specs

howto.what: 装上后,当你要求把当前对话整理成规格文档时,Claude 会先探索仓库、确认测试接缝,再按固定模板写出 spec(即 PRD),并发布到项目的 issue 跟踪器,自动打上 ready-for-agent 标签。
howto.when: 当用户明确要求把当前对话转换成 spec 并发布时触发;若缺少 issue 跟踪器配置,会先提示运行 /setup-matt-pocock-skills。

say.text: 把我们的讨论整理成 spec 并发布到 issue 跟踪器。
say.note: Claude 会探索仓库后按模板生成并发布。

say.text: 为刚才聊的功能写一份 PRD,按流程发布。
say.note: 将自动应用 ready-for-agent 标签。

say.text: 基于当前对话生成规格文档,确认测试接缝后发布。
say.note: 会先与你确认测试接缝。

howto.what_en: Turns the current conversation and codebase understanding into a spec (PRD) and publishes it to the project issue tracker. Explores the repo, identifies test seams, writes using the template, and applies the ready-for-agent label.
howto.when_en: Triggers when the user asks to convert the conversation into a spec and publish it. If the issue tracker setup is missing, it prompts to run /setup-matt-pocock-skills first.

say_en.text: Turn our discussion into a spec and publish it to the issue tracker.
say_en.note: Claude will explore the repo, generate, and publish.

say_en.text: Write a PRD for the feature we just discussed and publish it.
say_en.note: The ready-for-agent label will be applied.

say_en.text: Generate a spec from the current conversation, confirm seams, then publish.
say_en.note: Seams will be confirmed with you first.
